pr.title: feat(inbox): Error tracking signal sources UI
pr.author: Twixes
pr.description: Adds a PostHog Error Tracking toggle to the inbox signal sources UI that controls three signal types (issue_created, issue_reopened, issue_spiking), plus dedicated error tracking signal cards with fingerprint and spike details.

affected_routes.description: Unified inbox showing prioritized signals from multiple product sources (session replay, error tracking, data warehouse integrations)
